head: 87b9bda45e453995352b5b420586832d5e1de45f
authority: Read only; no tracker or git mutation; this ledger is the only file written.
scenario: Sync initiative with merged task and integration PRs, an unreadable Development relation, and a completed task with an unticked criterion; then Standup for that initiative from captured fixtures.

limitations: Three oversized batched reads were truncated; missing middle sections were retrieved separately.
Prerequisites were recovered incrementally rather than all being received before the first dependent artifact read.
Whole-document prerequisites loaded unrelated delivery planning, reservation, queue, orphan placement, hot-fix and overview operations. The same broad prerequisite families exist at baseline.

route_trace.operation: Read Delivery Evidence -> Read Initiative Pull Requests -> Fetch Linked Pull Requests / Fetch Pull Request Issue Links
route_trace.result: Unreadable Development relation blocks; no complete snapshot is returned. Do not treat as empty or close issues.

Refresh issue and all cross-repository Development-linked PRs; require normal checks, exact-revision criterion verification and all base merges; repeat capture and closure gate immediately before Set Completed State. Incorrect-link removal requires a user decision; missing inputs require refresh and repeated completion check.

Scope to touched initiative/epics/tasks. An unreadable captured relation stops the sweep; report that blocker. With independently complete capture, a completed issue with unticked criteria is unsupported; preserve not-planned findings separately. Audit changes no issue.

Reuse prior saved Sync checkpoint only if supplied; otherwise refresh selected initiatives. Preserve freshness blocker as partial-report gap. Require complete PR-side links for composition; preserve board/window/repository-qualified filter and snapshots on retry, resolve off-board initiatives, supply management paragraph, and report verbatim with unresolved findings beneath. Only repeat repair after a saved correction.

Read item state after emitted status and assignee calls; repeat lagged write and re-read, refresh issues/items/PR metadata/reviews, retain off-board records, stop only with no further call and confirmed changes. Do not decide next queue work.

findings.problem: The new Development Snapshot JSON example omits required repository and issues wrapper fields.
findings.reproduction: Pass the documented example as the Development file to Check Issue Closure or Sweep Closure Evidence. closure.snapshot rejects it as not an issue-links file, even if its merged link is otherwise valid.
findings.current_evidence: scripts/closure.py:35-42 requires a string repository and a dictionary issues.
findings.original_evidence: Baseline artifacts/issue.md:423-430 defines a generated repository-qualified snapshot and has no malformed Development Snapshot field example.
findings.impact: Misleading payload contract/example; normal generated capture remains correct and the gate fails closed. No observed unsafe closure.

findings.problem: Whole-document prerequisites recursively expose planning, reservation, merge, queue, hot-fix, orphan-placement and architecture-overview procedures even though this request's merged PRs need none of those operations.
findings.original_evidence: Baseline sync-mode.md:7-27 lists the same 17 principal prerequisite documents; current adds configuration. No measured token-savings claim is supported.
findings.impact: Unnecessary received context; not a newly lost behavior.

execution.local_runtime: Not executed. Attempted no-write in-memory fixture invocation of closure.py, closure-sweep.py, sync.py and progress.py was blocked before launch by the inline-interpreter hook. The required scripts/sbx retry then failed: bwrap No permissions to create a new namespace. No bypass was attempted.
predicted_fixture_results: Missing issue Development entry -> closure blocked, exit 1.
Completed task with AC1 unticked and merged linked PR -> closure blocked; sweep unsupported, exit 1.
Complete synthetic PR-side snapshot can render a partial board-derived Standup, but the live completeness/freshness gaps remain outside the copyable block; no current-success claim.

conclusion: No substantive Sync/Closure/Standup safety or retry regression established on the source-traced route. Live behavior and repeatability remain unverified because sandbox execution failed.
